name: SupermarketShoppingNoVaImpulseBuying

custom.system_prompt:
You are generating a realistic no-VA supermarket conversation. Sigma does not appear. One person keeps adding things to the cart that weren't on the list — the other keeps quietly editing it. This happens repeatedly.

Write dialogue that sounds like real people with different shopping styles in the same cart. Hard rules:
- Every line must be under 70 characters. No exceptions.
- Sigma does not appear at any point
- Hugo adds things because they're interesting; Nadia questions because she's practical today
- The pattern repeats 3-4 times with variation
- It's funny rather than frustrating — they enjoy this dynamic

sound_effects_config.prompt: Supermarket ambience, background store music, products being placed in cart, aisle browsing sounds

initial_prompt:
Generate a no-VA conversation where Hugo keeps adding things to the cart that weren't on the list — something discounted, something interesting, something he spotted. Nadia is more budget-conscious today and keeps questioning or quietly returning things. This pattern happens at least three times. Hugo makes his case each time with genuine enthusiasm. Sometimes he wins, sometimes he doesn't. The whole thing is warm and slightly funny — this is just how they shop.

Hard rules:
- Every line under 70 characters
- Sigma must not appear at any point
- Hugo's additions are always genuinely interesting, not frivolous
- Nadia's objections are always legitimate
- The pattern repeats but with variation — different items, different outcomes

user1.name: Hugo
user1.tts_prompt: Warm and unhurried, mild European accent, enthusiastic about finds

user2.name: Nadia
user2.tts_prompt: Intellectually engaged, mild European accent, practically firm today

variations.context: Hugo keeps adding off-list items — Nadia keeps questioning them

setting.mood: Warm and slightly comic. They know this about each other.
setting.relationship_dynamic: He finds things, she edits the cart — an established system

setting.conversation_style: Warm back-and-forth. Hugo makes cases, Nadia evaluates. Occasionally she agrees.
